content: Bism Allah Arrahman Arraheem بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ (In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful)
1) قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ [113:1] Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.
speaker: Qul A'uzu Bi Rabbil Falaq (113

content: 2) مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ [113:2] "From the evils among His creations.
speaker: Min Sharri Ma Khalaq (113

content: 3) وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ [113:3] "From the evils of darkness as it falls.
speaker: Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin Iza Waqab (113

content: 4) وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ [113:4] "From the evils of the troublemakers.
speaker: Wa Min Sharri Naffasati Fil Uqad (113

content: 5) وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ [113:5] "From the evils of the envious when they envy."
speaker: Wa Min Sharri Hasidin Iza Hasad (113

content: Bism Allah Arrahman Arraheem بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ (In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful)
1) قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ [114:1] Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the people.
speaker: Qul A'uzu Bi Rabbi Nnas (114

content: 2) مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ [114:2] "The King of the people.
speaker: Maliki Nnas (114

content: 3) إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ [114:3] "The god of the people.
speaker: Ilahi Nnas (114

content: 4) مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ [114:4] "From the evils of sneaky whisperers.
speaker: Min Sharril Waswasil Khannas (114

content: 5) ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ [114:5] "Who whisper into the chests of the people.
speaker: Allaziyu Waswasu Fi Suduri Nnas (114

content: 6) مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ [114:6] "Be they of the jinns, or the people."
speaker: Minal Jinnati Wa Nnas (114
